title: Plus yard
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：plus　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plus 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the shopkeeper kept the scale ① plus the three days of rain at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the scale had been left ② plus the far side of the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1952 puts it plainer. It was done ③ plus the cost of the wood, and the buyer who kept the scale had counted it ④ plus the help of two men twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done plus the cost of the wood in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ plus the want of a hammer, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ plus the need of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ plus a bag of nails, and that the names be written ⑧ plus the names of the dead. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried plus a bag of nails.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968 she kept the scale ⑨ plus the three days of rain again when nobody else would, and ⑩ plus the far side of the yard, she said in 1970, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done plus the far side of the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 加（表时间：plus the three days of rain）
B. prep. 加（表处所：plus the far side of the yard）
C. prep. 外加（表方式／状态：plus the cost of the wood）
D. prep. 外加（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted plus the help of two men）
E. prep. 加（表原因：plus the want of a hammer）
F. prep. 外加（表对象／目的：plus the need of the family）
G. prep. 加（表工具／材料：plus a bag of nails）
H. prep. 外加（表载体／处所：written plus the names of the dead）

items.q: plus the three days of rain
plus the far side of the yard
plus the cost of the wood
plus the help of two men
plus the want of a hammer
plus the need of the family
plus the names of the dead
plus the three days of rain again
plus the far side of the yard, she said

answers.why: plus 意为“加”，此处引出时间 the three days of rain（下雨的那三天），说明那件小小的秤是在何时留下的。
plus 意为“加”，此处引出处所 the far side of the yard（院子的那一边），说明东西被放在何处。
plus 意为“外加”，此处引出方式或状态 the cost of the wood（木料的价钱），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
plus 意为“外加”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 两个人的帮忙：be counted plus the help of two men。
plus 意为“加”，此处引出原因 the want of a hammer（因为缺一把锤子），说明整件事由何而起。
plus 意为“外加”，此处引出对象或目的 the need of the family（家里的需要）。
plus 意为“加”，此处引出工具或材料 a bag of nails（一袋钉子）。
plus 意为“外加”，此处引出载体 the names of the dead（死者的名字）：names written plus the names of the dead。
plus 意为“加”，1968 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的秤，此处仍引出时间 the three days of rain。
plus 意为“加”，母亲 1970 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院子的那一边。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年下雨的那三天前后，掌柜把那件小小的秤留在了柜台。（plus the three days of rain）
那件小小的秤被放在院子的那一边，谁也没有过问。（plus the far side of the yard）
整件事是木料的价钱做成的，账本上写得明白。（plus the cost of the wood）
入冬之前，那件小小的秤已经由两个人的帮忙数过两回。（be counted plus the help of two men）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为缺一把锤子起的。（plus the want of a hammer）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的需要做过这件事。（plus the need of the family）
answers: In 1958 the shopkeeper kept the scale plus the three days of rain at the counter.
The scale had been left plus the far side of the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done plus the cost of the wood, or so the account says.
The scale had been counted plus the help of two men twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun plus the want of a hammer.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it plus the need of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 plus 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the shopkeeper kept the scale plus the three days of rain, and nobody forgot it.
The scale had been left plus the far side of the yard for three months.
The work was done plus the cost of the wood, as it always was in those days.
The scale had been counted plus the help of two men twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the scale plus the three days of rain again when nobody else would.
The whole shop never forgot what had been done plus the far side of the yard.
